title: Close the loop on the service outcome
description: Inject an incident, choose a response and verification signal, then tune action scope, observation delay, cooldown, and attempts. The model exposes wrong action, oscillation, and false-success states.

scenarios.label: Demand exceeds capacity
scenarios.detail: Request demand rises above the verified serving envelope while dependencies remain healthy.

scenarios.label: Release increases errors
scenarios.detail: A new artifact causes elevated errors in the canary cohort.

scenarios.label: One zone stops serving
scenarios.detail: A failure domain loses healthy capacity and survivors approach saturation.

responses.label: Restart unhealthy processes
responses.detail: Replace local process state without changing capacity or release version.

responses.label: Add qualified capacity
responses.detail: Increase replicas in bounded steps after checking downstream headroom.

responses.label: Restore the qualified artifact
responses.detail: Remove the candidate change and return traffic to the stable version.

responses.label: Shift traffic to reserve
responses.detail: Drain the failed domain and admit traffic only where tested reserve exists.

verificationPolicies.label: Action API returned success
verificationPolicies.detail: The provider accepted the change, but the service consequence is unknown.

verificationPolicies.label: Resources look healthy
verificationPolicies.detail: Instances are ready, but user-visible latency and errors may still be degraded.

verificationPolicies.label: Service SLI recovered
verificationPolicies.detail: Fresh user-facing errors, latency, and saturation return inside the declared objective.
